hero.headline: Designing infrastructure that enables business.
hero.sub: I lead the architecture of secure, resilient enterprise platforms across cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments.
hero.copy: My focus is turning complex business and operational requirements into practical platforms that can be delivered, governed and sustained at enterprise scale.

profile.p1: I work at the point where business direction, architecture decisions and delivery reality meet. My role is to create a clear technical direction and ensure it remains practical from the first design discussion through production readiness.
profile.p2: I approach architecture as a decision-making discipline: understand the objective, expose constraints and risk, evaluate trade-offs, and establish a platform model that teams can implement and operate with confidence.
profile.p3: I stay engaged beyond the diagram—aligning stakeholders, challenging assumptions and adapting the design when implementation evidence shows that a better answer is required.

engagements.title: Enterprise Banking Platform Transformation
engagements.intro: Led the architecture and delivery of a greenfield enterprise banking platform, creating a secure and resilient foundation for a new operation in Saudi Arabia.
engagements.challenge: Enable a new banking operation through an enterprise platform that was secure, resilient and operationally ready, while coordinating internal functions and strategic technology partners around one delivery model.
engagements.scope: End-to-end cloud and infrastructure architecture covering regional deployment, enterprise networking, identity and shared services, high availability, disaster recovery, governance and operational readiness.
engagements.role: Served as the principal infrastructure stakeholder and architecture lead. Directed cross-team and vendor discussions, resolved critical design issues and adapted the architecture where delivery evidence required a more practical decision.
engagements.outcome: Established the secure and resilient platform foundation required for launch, continuity and long-term expansion, with technical delivery aligned across business stakeholders, engineering teams and strategic partners.
engagements.tech: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure · Jeddah primary region · Riyadh DR · enterprise networking · resilience

engagements.title: Enterprise Cloud Network Modernization
engagements.intro: Redesigned an enterprise cloud network and security model to improve control, scalability and operating efficiency while reducing recurring cost.
engagements.challenge: Modernize the existing cloud network and security model without weakening operational continuity, while addressing cost, governance and scalability constraints.
engagements.scope: Target-state network and security architecture, centralized connectivity, routing and segmentation, inspection design, migration planning and formal architecture documentation.
engagements.role: Owned the target architecture, design governance and implementation planning, validating that routing, inspection and operational behavior remained aligned with the intended control model.
engagements.outcome: Delivered a more secure, scalable and governable cloud foundation while reducing annual infrastructure operating cost by approximately $40,000.
engagements.tech: OCI · DRG · Palo Alto VM-Series · route tables · HLD

engagements.title: Regional Infrastructure Platform
engagements.intro: Designed and delivered a regional infrastructure platform that enabled secure operations, resilient connectivity and future expansion across locations.
engagements.challenge: Establish a production-ready regional platform that could operate securely, integrate with the existing environment and provide a dependable base for growth.
engagements.scope: Regional infrastructure architecture covering compute, identity, secure remote access, centralized management, network design, inter-site connectivity, operational services and architecture documentation.
engagements.role: Owned the infrastructure and network architecture, led cross-team design decisions and drove delivery of the core platform and secure regional connectivity.
engagements.outcome: Delivered a secure and operationally ready platform with standardized services, resilient inter-site connectivity and a documented foundation for support and future expansion.
engagements.tech: Hyper-V · Windows Server · Active Directory · RD Gateway · VPN · enterprise networking

engagements.title: Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement
engagements.intro: Improved the reliability and supportability of enterprise platforms by converting complex production findings into sustainable architecture and operating changes.
engagements.challenge: Increase reliability and operational maturity across platforms with multiple technologies, dependencies, teams and vendor boundaries.
engagements.scope: Architecture refinement, complex production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, automation, operational standardization, documentation and continuous service improvement.
engagements.role: Led cross-functional investigations, translated technical findings into durable design and operating improvements, and automated repeatable activities that created avoidable support effort.
engagements.outcome: Strengthened platform reliability and supportability, reduced recurring operational friction and established clearer technical and operating practices for continued improvement.
engagements.tech: Azure · PowerShell · automation · RCA · architecture documentation

journey.text: Expanded into regional enterprise architecture leadership across cloud, hybrid and on-premises platforms, with ownership spanning modernization, resilience and delivery governance.
Moved from domain expertise into end-to-end enterprise platform architecture, becoming a principal technical stakeholder for a greenfield banking operation in Saudi Arabia.
Built deeper enterprise and customer-facing experience through complex networks, large-scale incident resolution and cross-team service delivery.
Established the engineering foundation: disciplined operations, infrastructure troubleshooting and an understanding of how design decisions behave in production.

philosophy.p1: I believe the architect’s first responsibility is to make the important decisions explicit: what the platform must achieve, which constraints matter, where risk sits and how the design will be operated after delivery.
philosophy.p2: Architecture should be firm in its principles and adaptable in its implementation. When real evidence challenges an assumption, improving the design is stronger than defending the original diagram.
